$Comment: One node of the library's sample tree on the sample track, switched off like the rest of it: turn the track on in tracks.json and each Zc_Track_Example_Tree_* pick on in track-picks.json ({ "Zc_Track_Example_Tree_Toughness": { "Enabled": true }, ... }). A first-row node of the Guard branch: each of its three ranks costs a point and adds two health, and the points count toward Guard, which opens that branch's second row at five. /zigtrack pick --track=Zc_Track_Example --pick=Zc_Track_Example_Tree_Toughness takes a rank as the track's page would.
